name: doobers
note: Doobers / resources (owner, 2026-11-06): the collectible items that pop out of crops, trees, rocks, animals and stations, and the same pictures in the inventory and crafting panels. Today they are Twemoji glyphs baked into the atlas. The owner wants every resource as its own painted sprite, no emoji fallback: 2D, front-facing, in the game's style, but OVERSIZED and bolder than a prop of the same thing in a building scene, because a doober is a pickup that must read at ~45 px on grass. Round 1 = three directions on the 3 x 3 grid for the owner to pick a style.
preamble: A SHEET OF COLLECTIBLE ITEM SPRITES for a 2D fairy-tale farming RPG. The first {refCount} attached images are the game's own art: a building and its icon set, STYLE REFERENCES for palette, light and brushwork (warm earthy colours, bright warm daylight from the upper left, chunky hand-shaped forms, storybook, a little crooked, grown-up whimsy, never cutesy). These sprites are PICKUPS: the carrot that pops out of a harvested plot, the log from a felled tree, the egg from a coop. They sit on green grass at about 45 pixels tall and must read instantly there, so each is ONE bold object, OVERSIZED and simplified: the biggest shapes only, three or four colours, no small details, no texture noise, fatter and rounder than the real thing, a clear strong silhouette. Every item is seen flat-on from the FRONT at the same camera (no three-quarter turn, no perspective, no tilted top faces); symmetrical objects drawn symmetrically. All items on the sheet share one size (each fills about three quarters of its cell), one light, one rendering, so they clearly belong to one set. No background, no ground, no scene. The LAST attached image is the layout guide: a pure magenta (#FF00FF) field divided into a grid of equal cells by thin lines; draw exactly ONE item in the CENTRE of each cell, in the order given (left to right, then top to bottom), never touching or crossing a cell line, a clear magenta margin around every item; leave every other pixel pure magenta, no grid lines over the items, no vignette. No text, no letters, no numbers, no watermark, no frame.

variants.painted: RENDERING: soft painterly shading with a little brushwork, NO outline, depth from light and shadow, a small soft contact shadow under each item; exactly the rendering of the attached world art, so a pickup looks like a piece of the world that has come loose, only bigger and simpler.
variants.lined: RENDERING: the same painterly fill, but every item carries a thin, even, dark warm-brown OUTLINE around its whole silhouette and its two or three main inner shapes, like a hand-inked storybook plate; one shadow tone and one highlight per colour; no contact shadow; crisp and poppy so it separates from grass at a glance.
variants.glossy: RENDERING: smooth, rounded, juicy: forms pushed plumper and rounder, a soft gradient from lit side to shade, ONE bright glossy highlight on the main surface, a soft dark rim on the shadow side instead of an outline, no contact shadow; the look of a prize collectible, still in the game's warm earthy palette, never neon.
